chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Musa ibn Bakr from Zurara from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him)

Regarding the female slave, if her master has sexual relations with her and then frees her, then her waiting period (iddah) is three menstrual periods; and if he dies, then it is four months and ten days.

key_terms.غَشِيَهَا: he had sexual relations with her / covered her

ai.seo_question: What is the iddah of a freed female slave after sexual relations with her master?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), transmitted via the reliable chain of Zurarah, establishes the iddah for a freed slave woman (ummiyyah) based on the mode of termination of the master's ownership. It distinguishes between death and manumission, assigning three menstrual cycles for the former and four months and ten days for the latter, reflecting the juristic principle that the nature of the bond's dissolution dictates the waiting period. This ruling is significant in Shia fiqh for clarifying the status of concubines and their transition to free women.
